mentions.name: Lexicon
mentions.description: A vocabulary builder built around fun word puzzles, offering eight games including a daily challenge and original games like Cascade and Flipside. All games draw from a curated collection of words and definitions, and players can save interesting or useful words to their personal Lexicon to revisit meanings, example sentences, synonyms and antonyms later.
mentions.problem: English speakers want to discover new words or feel more confident using ones they already recognise.
mentions.audience: People who enjoy a daily word puzzle, and proficient English speakers who want to discover new words or feel more confident using ones they already recognise.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Lexicon (https://lexicon.zone), a vocabulary builder built around fun word puzzles.
